content:
Overview

Sioux City is a city in IA with a population of 82,000. Missouri River city in northwest Iowa with a growing meatpacking and logistics economy. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials.
